hypotheses.statement: The sample is too small (and incomplete) to show whether the conversion rate really changed.
hypotheses.confidenceRationale: Low sample and missing days; the test is not significant.

limitations: Produced by the deterministic policy (no AI): fixed rules and report templates applied to the tool results.

observations.statement: Between 2026-09-19…2026-10-02 vs 2026-10-03…2026-10-16 the tracked conversion rate went from 4.29% to 2.12% (−50.5%); the change is not statistically significant (p = 0.101).
Daily conversion rate averaged 5.19% before 2026-09-28 and 2.29% from 2026-09-28 on (change point; 9 vs 16 days, −55.8%).
No data for 3 date(s) in the analysed periods: 2026-10-10, 2026-10-11, 2026-10-12.
Low sample: 18 baseline and 7 current tracked conversions; detecting 4.29% vs 2.12% reliably needs about 1,038 sessions per period, available 420 and 330.
Pixel and backend agree: the pixel recorded 100% of backend-confirmed conversions in the baseline (18 of 18) and 100% in the current period (7 of 7).

evidenceIndex.E1: Baseline 2026-09-19…2026-10-02: 420 sessions, 18 tracked conversions, CR 4.29%, spend $237.35; current 2026-10-03…2026-10-16: 330 sessions, 7 tracked conversions, CR 2.12%, spend $186.19.
evidenceIndex.E2: No data for 3 date(s) in the analysed periods: 2026-10-10, 2026-10-11, 2026-10-12.
evidenceIndex.E3: Tracked CR changed from 4.29% (18 / 420 sessions, 2026-09-19…2026-10-02) to 2.12% (7 / 330 sessions, 2026-10-03…2026-10-16): −2.16 pp (−50.5%); two-proportion z-test p = 0.101, 95% CI of the difference [−4.65 pp, +0.32 pp] — not significant; −0.6 tracked conversions/day.
evidenceIndex.E4: Low sample: 18 baseline and 7 current tracked conversions; detecting 4.29% vs 2.12% reliably needs about 1,038 sessions per period, available 420 and 330.
evidenceIndex.E5: No data for 3 date(s) in the analysed periods: 2026-10-10, 2026-10-11, 2026-10-12.
evidenceIndex.E6: Daily conversion rate averaged 5.19% before 2026-09-28 and 2.29% from 2026-09-28 on (change point; 9 vs 16 days, −55.8%).
evidenceIndex.E7: No data for 3 date(s) in the analysed periods: 2026-10-10, 2026-10-11, 2026-10-12.
evidenceIndex.E8: Pixel and backend agree: the pixel recorded 100% of backend-confirmed conversions in the baseline (18 of 18) and 100% in the current period (7 of 7).
evidenceIndex.E9: Largest funnel step change: form_start→form_submit 0.2632 → 0.1034 (−60.7%); other steps: page_view→form_start 0.181 → 0.1758, form_submit→lead_submitted 0.9 → 1.1667.
